appearance.subtle: Their knuckles and elbows look swollen, and they move a little stiffly.
appearance.obvious: Bone has collared their joints into visible knots. They turn from the waist because their neck will not.
appearance.extreme: Every joint is a knurl of overgrown bone. They move like something assembled rather than grown, in straight lines and single planes.

description: Extra bone has grown a collar around every major joint. Hard to break. Hard to bend.
drawbacks: You have lost a lot of flexibility
name: Ossified Joints
